Container.Name: Ferret
Container.Overview:
Ferret is a self-hosted home inventory for the whole family: find anything you own. Add things by photo, barcode or a walk through a room, find them again by searching for what they are, print QR labels for boxes, and keep warranties, manuals, maintenance and an insurance report in one place. Several households and people with roles, a REST API and an MCP server for Claude and other AI assistants.
Set PUBLIC_URL and start it: Ferret makes its own secrets the first time. Then make a key file (Settings, Server, Keys) and keep it off the server: without FILES_KEY, uploaded photos and documents can't be read.
Every AI feature is optional and runs on your own models (Ollama, an OpenAI-compatible server, Qdrant, docling): set their addresses under "Show more settings". The help, from setup to the AI stack, is built in at /docs.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: inventory home-inventory belongings warranty insurance barcode labels qr mcp
Container.Requires: The appdata folder must belong to nobody:users (99:100), as Unraid's shares do; if Ferret's log says it can't write there, run: chown -R 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/ferret

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: The port for the web app, the API and /mcp.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database and the uploaded files (encrypted). Must belong to nobody:users (99:100).

Config.Name: AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Leave empty: Ferret makes one the first time and keeps it in its data folder. To set your own: openssl rand -base64 32.

Config.Name: FILES_KEY
Config.Description: The key every photo and document is sealed with. Leave empty: Ferret makes one the first time and keeps it in its data folder (appdata backups include it). To set your own: openssl rand -base64 32. Either way, make a key file once Ferret runs (Settings, Server, Keys) and keep it off the server: without the key, nothing uploaded can be read.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: The address people use to reach Ferret, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8787 or https://ferret.example.com behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: VAPID_SUBJECT
Config.Description: Push notifications work without setup. Apple's push service (iPhones, iPads, Safari) needs a contact on a public domain, e.g. mailto:you@example.com; without one, push reaches only other browsers when Ferret is reached by a local name or address. Leave empty to use admin@ the PUBLIC_URL's host.

Config.Name: ALLOW_SIGNUP
Config.Description: Set to false once everyone has an account (invited people can still join from their link). Every account but the first confirms its email, so more accounts need MAIL_URL.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Optional nightly backups, encrypted and checked: a folder, ideally on another disk or machine. Set BACKUP_DIR to /backups as well. Must belong to nobody:users (99:100).

Config.Name: BACKUP_DIR
Config.Description: Set to /backups to turn on nightly backups into the Backups folder above.

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: Behind a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, Traefik, a tunnel): its IP address(es), comma separated, so visitors' own addresses are believed from it and nobody else.

Config.Name: MAIL_URL
Config.Description: Email for Ferret itself (account confirmations, password resets, invitations), as an Apprise mailto:// or mailtos:// URL. Needs APPRISE_URL.

Config.Name: APPRISE_URL
Config.Description: An Apprise API container (caronc/apprise, with APPRISE_STATEFUL_MODE=disabled), e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000: reminders to ntfy, Pushover, Telegram, email and more, and Ferret's own email.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_URL
Config.Description: Optional: Ollama, for reading photos (VISION_MODEL, default qwen3-vl:8b) and search by meaning (EMBED_MODEL, default qwen3-embedding:8b).

Config.Name: CHAT_URL
Config.Description: Optional: an OpenAI-compatible server (…/v1) for Ask Ferret and reading documents (CHAT_MODEL, default gpt-oss-120b). Without it the vision model does both.

Config.Name: QDRANT_URL
Config.Description: Optional: Qdrant, for search by meaning (needs OLLAMA_URL too).

Config.Name: QDRANT_API_KEY
Config.Description: Qdrant's API key, if it has one.

Config.Name: DOCLING_URL
Config.Description: Optional: docling-serve, for the text of PDFs and photographed documents (manuals, receipts).

Config.Name: BARCODE_LOOKUP
Config.Description: Set to upcitemdb to look up barcodes nobody in your household has named yet (only the barcode is sent; 100 lookups a day free).

Config.Name: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
Config.Description: Optional: push notifications to the installed app. Generate both keys with: npx web-push generate-vapid-keys

Config.Name: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
Config.Description: The private half of the push keys above.

Config.Name: OIDC_ISSUER
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on (Authelia, Authentik, Pocket ID, Keycloak…): the provider's address. Redirect URI: PUBLIC_URL/api/auth/callback/oidc

Config.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: The client registered at the provider.

Config.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: The client's secret.

Config.Name: OIDC_NAME
Config.Description: The provider's name on the sign-in button, e.g. Authelia.

Config.Name: MAX_UPLOAD_MB
Config.Description: The largest upload accepted, in MB.
